# P4-020 — Restricted curriculum sources (buy or exclude)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Accepted (builder default; Tope may override) |
| Date | 2026-10-23 |
| Cards | P4-020 |
| RTM ids | CP-§2.3-23, CP-§2.3-21, CP-§2.3-20, CP-§2.3-22, CP-§2.3-18 |
| Sources | `CURRICULUM.md#§2.3:L226-L262` |

## Decision

| Source | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Masakhane data (mafand-mt and masakhaner-2) | **Exclude.** CC BY-NC 4.0 and no commercial licence is recorded. |
| NaijaVoices | **Exclude.** CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and the membership waiver is not purchased. |
| Kamusi | **Exclude.** CC BY-NC-SA. The Swahili-gap decision is optional and no request has been sent. |
| Helsinki Corpus of Swahili 2.0 | **Exclude.** Academic-only CLARIN ACA. The ELRA prices are an unverified curriculum quote and nothing is purchased. |
| Oxford Languages | **Buy,** conditional on a signed quote that covers tone-marked headwords, examples, and the right to display. **Fallback:** exclude, with Wiktionary as evidence only. The quote has not been sent and no purchase is recorded. |

## Options considered

| Option | For | Against |
|---|---|---|
| Exclude all five now | No quote, waiver, or ELRA purchase exists; licences stay honest. | Defers Oxford and any future waiver until commercial terms exist. |
| Buy all five now | Would satisfy curriculum coverage if licences were in place. | No quote, waiver, or ELRA purchase exists; treating sources as bought would be incorrect. |
| Treat Oxford as already bought | — | The quote is unsent; no purchase is recorded. |

## Consequences

The exclusion table stays as it is. Oxford remains licence-required. Wiktionary stays evidence only and is not copied into a lexicon. No money is spent by this ADR.

## Verification

The five decisions are in the Decision section and Oxford's fallback names Wiktionary evidence only.
